[ANCHOR 1]
First up, here's what's going on. Wednesday is Education Support Professionals Day. It's a day to thank the people who keep our schools running, like custodians, cafeteria workers, and bus drivers.

[ANCHOR 2]
Thursday is National Parental Involvement Day. It's a day to thank the parents and families who help out at school and at home.

[ANCHOR 1]
Thanks, [ANCHOR 2]. The La Joya ISD Conjunto Showcase is Thursday at 6:30 p.m. [VERIFY: location] It's a great way to support our student musicians.

[ANCHOR 2]
Friday is Substitute Appreciation Day. Substitute teachers step in when our teachers are out, and they help keep our classes going.

[ANCHOR 1]
Mark your calendars. Next week is Thanksgiving Break, so there's no school Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27. Classes start back up Monday, November 30.

[ANCHOR 2]

Stay with us. [WEATHER REPORTER] has the weather after the break.

[CUE BUMPER]

[WEATHER]
Good morning, RedWolves! I'm [WEATHER REPORTER]. Let's take a look at this week's weather forecast!
We're starting the week off mild on Monday, with a high of 74 degrees. Expect partly sunny skies, a morning low of 65, and a 14 percent chance of rain.
Tuesday stays about the same, with a high of 72. Expect partly sunny skies, a morning low of 59, and no rain.
Wednesday warms up to 76 degrees. Expect partly sunny skies, a morning low of 62, and no rain.
Thursday warms up to 80 degrees. Expect mostly cloudy skies, a morning low of 67, and an 11 percent chance of rain.
Friday warms up to 83 degrees. Expect mostly cloudy skies, a morning low of 69, and no rain.
Have a great week, RedWolves!
